learnPageBusinessStructure.title: Choose a business structure
learnPageBusinessStructure.overview: Before you register your business, you need to choose a structure. Your choice affects how you pay taxes, how much personal risk you take on, and which forms you need to file.

simpleWords.text: Owners are usually not personally responsible for the business's debts
It combines features of a corporation and a partnership
Profits are reported on the owners' personal tax returns

advantages.text: Protects your personal assets from most business debts
Flexible choice of how the business is taxed

disadvantages.text: Costs more to set up than a sole proprietorship
Some investors prefer to fund corporations instead

simpleWords.text: The simplest way to run a business on your own
You and the business are legally the same

advantages.text: You keep full control of every decision

disadvantages.text: You are personally responsible for all business debts
It can be harder to raise money from investors

simpleWords.text: Two or more people share ownership of one business
Partners manage the business together and share its debts

advantages.text: Simple to start and to run
Partners report profits on their personal tax returns

disadvantages.text: Each partner can be responsible for the others' business decisions
Disagreements between partners can be hard to resolve
